findings.issue: The page gauge and the declared effective total disagree. publish.py recomputes decay on Toronto calendar days (28 Oct to 4 Nov = 7 days -> x1.0 -> 10), while Rates_decisions/app.js decayFactor uses fractional days, so the 28 Oct drivers are 7.59 days old and decay x0.75, rendering +9.25. The candidate's own renderer note claims the gauge prints +9.5, which matches neither arithmetic. Both land in strong hike lean, so no band or weight changes.
